text: WITH r AS (SELECT SUM(product_price) AS revenue FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-01-01'), c AS (SELECT SUM(o.order_cost) AS cost FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders" AS o WHERE o.order_id IN (SELECT oi.order_id FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" AS oi WHERE oi.ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND oi.ordered_at < '2026-01-01')) SELECT r.revenue - c.cost AS gross_profit_2025, (r.revenue - c.cost) * 100.0 / r.revenue AS gross_margin_pct_2025 FROM r, c
